name: 2-ngay
prompt:
Edit the first attached image (a rice field scene with sun, rain cloud and wind). Changes:
1. Make the rice field THICKER and denser: more rice plants, fuller clumps, filling the whole width of the field, still the same simple flat style of rice plants.
2. Add BA and ME (father and mother) standing in the field among the rice, waist-deep in the rice, on the left half of the field, caring for the rice: ME (like the woman in the second attached picture: conical non la hat, brown blouse) gently holds a rice head and looks at the grains; BA stands next to her, checking a rice plant. Both are smiling softly. They are small compared to the scene, like the people in the other story scenes.
BA (the father) must look like this: a thin Vietnamese man about 65 to 70 years old, short grey-white hair (mostly grey, a little dark at the back), a thin face with high cheekbones and a kind, quiet smile, slim build. He wears a plain dark grey button-up shirt with rolled sleeves and light khaki trousers, sandals. No cap.

Keep the sun, the cloud with rain drops and the wind lines in the sky.
KEEP THE STYLE EXACTLY like the attached scene: simple, rustic flat cartoon illustration, flat colour fills, even dark-brown outlines, no shading, no gradients, no texture, no extra detail. Same colours, same sky, same ground bands, same framing, keep the important content inside a central 2:1 band. People drawn in the same simple flat style as the attached character pictures. No text, no letters, no watermark.
